Class IuJsonbModel.Creator

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.IuJsonbModel.Creator
Enclosing class:
IuJsonbModel
static final class IuJsonbModel.Creator extends Object
Creates a business object from values read from JSON, with its parameters' configured conversions.
